text: Welcome to Digitix Labs H R M S, your complete human resource management platform.
The dashboard shows attendance trends, pending approvals, and team stats in real time.
Employees check in and check out easily, with working hours and late arrivals tracked automatically.
Apply for leave, view balances, and let managers approve or apply leave on behalf of their team.
Manage employee profiles, departments, designations, and your full organization hierarchy.
Generate and manage payslips with salary, net pay, and one-click P D F download.
Run detailed reports on attendance, leave, and employees, and export to Excel, C S V, or P D F.
Digitix Labs H R M S. Simplify H R operations and empower your workforce.
